body: T-Pain sues Akon’s Konvict Entertainment imprint with a major lawsuit alleging that the label owes him nearly $500k in unpaid royalties. According to documents obtained by XXL on Tuesday (Sept. 8). In an 80-page filing that was filed in Fulton County Superior Court on Sept. 4, Teddy P alleges that Konvict Entertainment owes him $489,047 from a $1.3 million royalty payment it received on March 30, 2026, from Zomba Recordings (a distributor).
